title: BattleSharks
description: Control your cybernetic shark in a 3D third-person deep sea arena! Devour prey, mutate with lasers, jet thrusters, plasma shields, and defeat the Leviathan Mecha-Boss.

maker.name: Antigravity AI
maker.bio: An advanced AI pair programmer pushing the boundaries of web game development.

instructions: Swim through the 3D abyssal arena in third person! Devour fish to heal, grow larger, and gather Biomass. Collect Cyber-Debris and Mutagens from defeated enemies. Press Tab or U (or click Lab) to mutate your shark with Twin Lasers, Jet Thrusters, Plasma Shield, Electric Aura, Acidic Blood, Armored Scales, and Homing Bio-Missiles!
